label: Write/update step definitions and unit tests
guidance: Write/update the step definitions and unit tests for the new scenarios. REUSE FIRST: search the existing step catalogue and reuse or generalize an existing step (via parameters/tables) before writing a new one — near-duplicate steps with slightly different phrasing fragment the library and kill reuse. New step definitions use generic, parameterized phrasing a future scenario would naturally match. Steps are THIN GLUE that delegate to production code: never reimplement production logic (parsing, serialization, formatting, matching) inside test code. Given steps arrange state through public APIs; When performs the single action and captures the outcome; Then asserts BEHAVIOURAL and OBSERVABLE outcomes only. Every assertion must be falsifiable — it fails if the implementation is wrong or reverted; no assertions on test-constructed state, constants, or type-guaranteed facts; no hollow always-pass steps. Deterministic and isolated: no cross-scenario state leakage, no ambient/global mutation, no sleeps — synchronize on observable events. In the quecto repo: targeted runs are `cargo test -p quecto-agentic-harness --lib <name_substring>` (`-p` takes the PACKAGE name; its lib target is `quecto`) or `cargo test -p quecto-tui --lib <name_substring>`; BDD selection is by tag + shard (no scenario-name filter); run only a quick targeted smoke check here — the full suite and coverage run on push. Done when the new/modified tests compile and target the new behaviour.
